allow_instructions: Allow read-only commands that inspect files, directories, Git state, logs, processes, ports, build output, dependency trees, and local service health.
Allow edits, formatting, compilation, tests, linting, static analysis, code generation, and local Git commits when all affected files remain inside the currently opened Debina workspace.
Allow Maven Wrapper goals for compile, test, verify, package, local Spring Boot execution, dependency inspection, and formatting, but not deploy or release goals.
Allow pnpm commands for frozen-lockfile installation, tests, linting, type checking, formatting, builds, Nuxt development, and Playwright tests, but not package publishing or arbitrary dlx execution.
Allow rootless Podman inspection, project image builds, and project Compose start, stop, restart, build, logs, config, and up operations without privileged mode or destructive volume removal.
Allow HTTP requests only to localhost or 127.0.0.1 for development API checks.
block_instructions: Require approval for sudo, su, doas, dnf, rpm, flatpak, systemctl, loginctl, firewall-cmd, sysctl changes, SELinux changes, kernel changes, reboot, shutdown, or any host administration.

Require approval for commands that read, print, copy, upload, or modify secrets, environment files, credentials, tokens, private keys, SSH files, GPG files, cloud configuration, Docker authentication, Keycloak secrets, or production configuration.

Require approval for rm, rmdir, shred, find -delete, find -exec, xargs, destructive sed operations outside the workspace, git clean, git reset --hard, branch deletion, force push, push --mirror, or rewriting shared remote history.

Require approval for git push, GitHub or GitLab write operations, publishing packages, Maven deploy or release, container registry push, cloud changes, deployments, or any other remote-state mutation.
Require approval for pnpm add, pnpm remove, pnpm update, pnpm publish, pnpm dlx, npx, or any wrapper capable of executing an arbitrary downloaded command.
Require approval for bash -c, sh -c, zsh -c, eval, exec, source, env used as a command wrapper, or any attempt to bypass the configured command prefixes.

Require approval for podman rm, podman rmi, podman system prune, podman volume rm, podman compose down with volumes, privileged containers, host-network containers, or mounting sensitive host directories.

Require approval for psql statements, Flyway migrate or clean, Liquibase update or rollback, database schema changes, DROP, TRUNCATE, mass DELETE, production database access, or non-local database hosts.
Require approval for curl, wget, ssh, scp, sftp, rsync, netcat, or other outbound network access to anything other than localhost or 127.0.0.1.
Require approval for writing outside the current repository, modifying ~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, ~/.profile, ~/.gitconfig, ~/.cursor, .git/hooks, IDE settings, shell startup files, or system directories.
